title: coord exchanges claims with any external coordination service through a JSON-lines contract: live intents and touches out, external reservations in as overlaps
goal: coord.py export-intents prints each live intent with its session, items and touch globs as JSON lines; coord.py import-reservations FILE|- takes JSON lines of holder, paths (globs), expires_in (seconds) and source and stores them as leases of their own that expire on their own; digest and the coord hook show an imported reservation that meets a session's touches as an overlap, as they show a session's; the contract is documented in coordination.md with no product named; on a temp store an imported reservation's holder appears in the digest.

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
t=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'c.sqlite')
c=lambda *a:s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/coord.py',*a,'--store',t],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
c('claim','session/s1','--holder','s1','--ttl','600')
c('post','--kind','intent','--field','session=s1','--field','item=ST-aaaaaaaa','--field','touch=src/auth/*')
p=c('export-intents');print(p.returncode,p.stdout[-500:],p.stderr[-300:])
rows=[]
for l in p.stdout.splitlines():
    try:
        rows.append(json.loads(l))
    except ValueError:
        pass
ok=p.returncode==0 and any('s1' in json.dumps(r) and 'ST-aaaaaaaa' in json.dumps(r) and 'src/auth/*' in json.dumps(r) for r in rows)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time
d=tempfile.mkdtemp();t=os.path.join(d,'c.sqlite');f=os.path.join(d,'r.jsonl')
open(f,'w').write(json.dumps({'holder':'ext-agent-1','paths':['src/auth/*'],'expires_in':600,'source':'external'})+chr(10)+json.dumps({'holder':'ext-agent-2','paths':['src/auth/*'],'expires_in':1,'source':'external'})+chr(10))
a=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/coord.py','import-reservations',f,'--store',t],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60)
time.sleep(3)
b=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/coord.py','digest','--store',t,'--key','src/auth/login.py','--lines','20'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60)
print(a.returncode,a.stdout[-300:],a.stderr[-300:],b.stdout[-400:])
ok=a.returncode==0 and b.returncode==0 and 'ext-agent-1' in b.stdout and 'ext-agent-2' not in b.stdout
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import importlib.util as u,json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
d=tempfile.mkdtemp();t=os.path.join(d,'c.sqlite');f=os.path.join(d,'r.jsonl');os.environ['KB_COORD_STORE']=t
open(f,'w').write(json.dumps({'holder':'ext-agent-1','paths':['src/auth/*'],'expires_in':600,'source':'external'})+chr(10))
a=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/coord.py','import-reservations',f,'--store',t],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60)
b=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/coord.py','digest','--store',t,'--key','src/auth/login.py','--lines','20'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60)
sp=u.spec_from_file_location('h','.claude/hooks/coord_hook.py');h=u.module_from_spec(sp);sp.loader.exec_module(h)
o=h.overlaps('s-mine',['src/auth/login.py'])
print(a.returncode,a.stderr[-200:],b.stdout[-300:],o)
ok=a.returncode==0 and 'ext-agent-1' in b.stdout and 'ext-agent-1' in json.dumps(o)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import re,sys
t=open('kb/_self/coordination.md',encoding='utf-8').read()
paras=[p for p in re.split(r'\n\s*\n',t) if 'import-reservations' in p or 'export-intents' in p]
names=re.findall(r'(?i)agent mail|mcp_agent_mail|\bbeads\b|\bherdr\b|\bclash\b|\bweave\b',' '.join(paras))
print(len(paras),'paragraphs name the contract; product names in them:',names)
sys.exit(0 if paras and any('import-reservations' in p for p in paras) and any('export-intents' in p for p in paras) and not names else 1)

gates.question: Does an imported external reservation refuse a coord claim on the same paths, or only show as an overlap?
options: only show as an overlap, like a session's touches
refuse a claim whose touches it covers until it expires
gates.recommendation: only show as an overlap, like a session's touches
gates.reason: the coord hook never blocks, and the operator decides
gates.answer: only show as an overlap, like a session's touches
